problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift in Scotland.
- It opened in 2002.
- It connects two canals that sit at different heights.
- The wheel lifts boats about 24 meters, from the lower canal to the upper one.
- Before the wheel was built, boats passed between the canals using a series of 11 locks.
- A single turn of the wheel takes about five minutes.

The student wants to explain the purpose of the Falkirk Wheel. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Falkirk Wheel is a rotating boat lift in Scotland.
- It opened in 2002.
- It connects two canals that sit at different heights.
- The wheel lifts boats about 24 meters, from the lower canal to the upper one.
- Before the wheel was built, boats passed between the canals using a series of 11 locks.
- A single turn of the wheel takes about five minutes.
problem.question: The student wants to explain the purpose of the Falkirk Wheel. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: The Falkirk Wheel, which opened in 2002, is located in Scotland.
A single turn of the Falkirk Wheel takes about five minutes.
Before 2002, boats in Scotland used a series of 11 locks.
The Falkirk Wheel moves boats about 24 meters between a lower canal and an upper canal, connecting two waterways at different heights.
problem.explanation: 목표는 팔커크 휠의 '목적', 즉 이 구조물이 무엇을 하기 위해 존재하는지를 설명하는 것이다. D는 높이가 다른 두 운하 사이에서 배를 약 24미터 들어 올려 두 수로를 연결한다고 말하므로 목적을 직접 설명한다. A는 개장 연도와 위치만 알려 줄 뿐 휠이 무슨 일을 하는지는 말하지 않는다. B는 회전 속도라는 세부 사항만 제시한다. C는 휠이 생기기 전의 상황을 말할 뿐 휠 자체는 언급하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain the Falkirk Wheel's purpose, meaning what it was built to do. D does exactly that: it says the wheel lifts boats about 24 meters between a lower canal and an upper canal, connecting two waterways at different heights. A only tells you when and where the wheel opened, not what it does. B gives a detail about how long one turn takes, but it doesn't explain why the wheel exists. C describes how boats traveled before the wheel was built and never mentions the wheel at all.

hardJudge.note: D만이 휠의 기능(배를 들어 올려 높이가 다른 두 운하 연결)을 서술하여 '목적' 설명 목표에 부합. A·B·C는 각각 연도/위치, 회전 시간, 휠 이전 상황만 다루는 전형적 오답(관련 없는 세부 사항)으로 easy 난이도에 적절. 노트 사실(2002년 개장, 24m, 11개 갑문, 약 5분)과 실제 Falkirk Wheel 정보 일치. 한·영 해설 모두 D를 일관되게 지지하며 글자 참조 정확, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음.

advisory.note: 정답 D만 휠의 기능(높이가 다른 운하 사이로 배를 옮김)을 설명함. C는 노트의 '운하 사이'라는 정보를 '스코틀랜드의 배'로 일반화했지만 오답 선택지라 문제가 되지 않음. 사실관계(2002년 개장, 약 24m, 회전 1회 약 5분)는 실제와 맞음. 오답들은 단순한 세부 사항이어서 easy 난이도에 적절함.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Pacific tree frog (Pseudacris regilla) and the American bullfrog (Lithobates catesbeianus) both breed in ponds in western North America.
- Pacific tree frog tadpoles complete metamorphosis in about two to three months.
- Bullfrog tadpoles often remain in the water for one to three years before metamorphosing.
- Because of this, Pacific tree frogs can breed successfully in temporary ponds that dry up by late summer.
- Bullfrogs generally require permanent ponds that hold water year-round.

The student wants to explain why the two frog species differ in the kinds of ponds they can use for breeding. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Pacific tree frog (Pseudacris regilla) and the American bullfrog (Lithobates catesbeianus) both breed in ponds in western North America.
- Pacific tree frog tadpoles complete metamorphosis in about two to three months.
- Bullfrog tadpoles often remain in the water for one to three years before metamorphosing.
- Because of this, Pacific tree frogs can breed successfully in temporary ponds that dry up by late summer.
- Bullfrogs generally require permanent ponds that hold water year-round.
problem.question: The student wants to explain why the two frog species differ in the kinds of ponds they can use for breeding. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Both the Pacific tree frog and the American bullfrog breed in ponds in western North America, though bullfrogs generally require permanent ponds.
Pacific tree frog tadpoles metamorphose in about two to three months, while bullfrog tadpoles often remain in the water for one to three years.
Pacific tree frogs can breed successfully in temporary ponds that dry up by late summer, whereas bullfrogs generally require permanent ponds that hold water year-round.

Because Pacific tree frog tadpoles metamorphose within a few months, the species can breed in ponds that dry up by late summer, whereas bullfrogs, whose tadpoles may stay aquatic for years, need ponds that hold water year-round.
problem.explanation: 목표는 두 종이 이용하는 연못 종류가 '왜' 다른지 설명하는 것이므로, 원인(올챙이 발달 기간)과 결과(연못 종류)를 연결해야 한다. D는 짧은 변태 기간→일시적 연못 가능, 긴 수중 기간→영구 연못 필요라는 인과를 두 종 모두에 대해 제시한다. A는 공통 서식지와 한 종의 요구 조건만 말할 뿐 이유가 없다. B는 원인(발달 기간)만 대조하고 연못 종류와 연결하지 않는다. C는 결과(연못 종류 차이)만 대조하고 그 이유를 빠뜨린다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to explain why the species differ in pond use, so the sentence must link a cause (tadpole development time) to an effect (pond type). D does exactly this for both species: quick metamorphosis allows use of ponds that dry up, while years-long tadpole stages require year-round water. A mentions the shared region and one species' requirement but gives no reason. B contrasts development times (the cause) without connecting them to pond type. C contrasts pond types (the effect) but leaves out the reason behind the difference.

hardJudge.note: D is the only choice that connects cause (tadpole development duration) to effect (pond type) for both species, directly fulfilling the 'explain why' goal. B (cause only) and C (effect only) are strong partial distractors requiring comparison; A is plausible but weakest. Content matches the notes; biological facts are accurate. Korean and English explanations are consistent and correctly reference choice letters. Standard SAT format, no copyright concerns. Medium difficulty is appropriate.

advisory.note: B(원인만)와 C(결과만)가 각각 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 갖는 전형적인 medium 구성. D만 인과를 연결한다. 정답이 유일하게 가장 길어서 길이로 찍을 수 있다는 점은 사소한 약점이다. 생물학적 사실(변태 기간)은 대체로 정확하다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the 1840s, most letters in Britain were paid for by the recipient, and the cost depended on distance and number of sheets.
- Sending a single-sheet letter from London to Edinburgh could cost more than a laborer's daily wage.
- In 1840, reformer Rowland Hill's proposal led to the Uniform Penny Post, which charged a flat one-penny rate paid in advance by the sender.
- The Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp, was introduced to show that postage had been prepaid.
- The number of letters delivered in Britain rose from about 76 million in 1839 to about 169 million in 1840.

The student wants to emphasize the effect of the Uniform Penny Post on how much the British public used the mail. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- In the 1840s, most letters in Britain were paid for by the recipient, and the cost depended on distance and number of sheets.
- Sending a single-sheet letter from London to Edinburgh could cost more than a laborer's daily wage.
- In 1840, reformer Rowland Hill's proposal led to the Uniform Penny Post, which charged a flat one-penny rate paid in advance by the sender.
- The Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp, was introduced to show that postage had been prepaid.
- The number of letters delivered in Britain rose from about 76 million in 1839 to about 169 million in 1840.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize the effect of the Uniform Penny Post on how much the British public used the mail. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Before 1840, a single-sheet letter sent from London to Edinburgh could cost more than a laborer's daily wage, and the recipient usually paid the charge.
The Uniform Penny Post, proposed by Rowland Hill, introduced the Penny Black, the world's first adhesive postage stamp, to show that a sender had prepaid.

After the Uniform Penny Post replaced distance-based charges with a flat one-penny rate in 1840, the number of letters delivered in Britain more than doubled, from about 76 million to about 169 million.
In 1840, Rowland Hill's reform replaced a system in which costs depended on distance and number of sheets with one in which senders paid in advance.
problem.explanation: 목표는 우편 개혁이 대중의 우편 이용량에 미친 '효과'를 강조하는 것이므로, 개혁 내용과 이용량 변화(편지 수 증가)를 연결해야 한다. C는 균일 1페니 요금 도입과 편지 배달 수가 약 7,600만에서 1억 6,900만으로 두 배 이상 늘어난 사실을 결합해 효과를 보여 준다. A는 개혁 이전의 높은 비용만 설명할 뿐 개혁 결과를 말하지 않는다. B는 우표 도입이라는 개혁의 특징을 제시하지만 이용량 변화가 없다. D는 제도 변화를 정확히 요약하지만 그 결과인 이용 증가를 언급하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: Your goal is to emphasize the reform's effect on how much people used the mail, so the answer must link the reform to the change in letter volume. C does this by pairing the flat one-penny rate with the rise in letters delivered from about 76 million to about 169 million, which is more than double. A only describes the high costs before the reform and never shows what the reform did. B presents a feature of the reform, the first adhesive stamp, but says nothing about mail volume. D accurately summarizes how the system changed, but it leaves out the result: increased mail use.

hardJudge.note: C는 개혁(균일 1페니 요금)과 이용량 변화(7,600만→1억 6,900만, 두 배 이상)를 연결해 목표를 충족. 수치 검산 일치. A는 개혁 이전 비용, B는 우표 도입, D는 제도 변화만 서술하여 효과 누락. 역사적 사실(1840년 Uniform Penny Post, Penny Black, Rowland Hill, 편지 수치)에 오류 없음. 해설 한·영 일치, 글자 참조 정확. 난이도 medium 적합.

advisory.note: 검산 결과 169/76 ≈ 2.22이므로 'more than doubled'는 맞다. 역사적 수치(1839년 약 7,600만 통 → 1840년 약 1억 6,900만 통)와 Penny Black 관련 사실도 정확하다. D와 B는 개혁 내용을 정확히 담고 있어 부분적으로 그럴듯하다. 다만 이용량 수치가 C에만 있어 다소 쉬운 편이며, 난이도는 medium 범위 안에 든다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Engineers in the Netherlands built the Maeslantkering, a storm-surge barrier near Rotterdam, completed in 1997.
- The barrier consists of two huge hinged gates, each about 210 meters long, that normally rest in dry docks on the riverbanks.
- When a severe storm surge is forecast, the dry docks are flooded, and the gates float out and swing shut across the waterway.
- Once closed, the gates are partially filled with water so that they sink and block the surge.
- Because the gates stay out of the channel most of the time, large cargo ships can pass freely to and from the Port of Rotterdam.
- The barrier was first closed in an actual storm in 2007.

The student wants to explain how the Maeslantkering's design allows it to protect against flooding without obstructing shipping. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- Engineers in the Netherlands built the Maeslantkering, a storm-surge barrier near Rotterdam, completed in 1997.
- The barrier consists of two huge hinged gates, each about 210 meters long, that normally rest in dry docks on the riverbanks.
- When a severe storm surge is forecast, the dry docks are flooded, and the gates float out and swing shut across the waterway.
- Once closed, the gates are partially filled with water so that they sink and block the surge.
- Because the gates stay out of the channel most of the time, large cargo ships can pass freely to and from the Port of Rotterdam.
- The barrier was first closed in an actual storm in 2007.
problem.question: The student wants to explain how the Maeslantkering's design allows it to protect against flooding without obstructing shipping. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Completed in 1997 near Rotterdam, the Maeslantkering was first closed during an actual storm in 2007, ten years after it was built.
The Maeslantkering's two hinged gates, each about 210 meters long, float out and swing shut when the dry docks holding them are flooded.
Large cargo ships can pass freely to and from the Port of Rotterdam, near where Dutch engineers built the Maeslantkering storm-surge barrier.
The Maeslantkering's gates rest in riverbank dry docks, leaving the channel open for cargo ships, until a surge is forecast; then they float out, swing shut, and sink to block the water.
problem.explanation: 목표는 설계가 어떻게 (1) 홍수를 막으면서 (2) 선박 통행을 막지 않는지를 함께 설명하는 것이다. D는 평소 수문이 강둑 건선거에 있어 항로가 열려 있다는 점과 해일 예보 시 떠올라 닫히고 가라앉아 물을 막는다는 점을 연결해 두 조건을 모두 충족한다. A는 완공 연도와 첫 가동이라는 연혁만 제시해 설계를 설명하지 않는다. B는 수문이 닫히는 방식만 설명하고 선박 통행과의 관계는 빠져 있다. C는 선박 통행은 언급하지만 그것이 설계 때문이라는 점과 홍수 방어 방식을 설명하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The goal has two parts: you need to show how the design (1) protects against flooding and (2) keeps shipping unobstructed. D links both ideas: the gates sit in dry docks on the riverbanks, which keeps the channel open, and when a surge is forecast they float out, swing shut, and sink to block the water. A gives only the barrier's history (when it was finished and when it was first used), so it doesn't explain the design at all. B explains how the gates close but never connects the design to shipping. C mentions that ships can pass, but it doesn't say the design is the reason, and it doesn't explain how the barrier stops floods.

hardJudge.note: D만이 목표의 두 요소(홍수 방어 메커니즘 + 항로 개방)를 모두 노트 정보로 연결함. B(닫힘 메커니즘만), C(선박 통행만)는 부분적 근거가 있어 비교 필요, A는 연혁만으로 말이 되는 오답. 해설 한·영 일치, 사실관계(1997 완공, 210m, 2007 첫 폭풍 가동) 정확.

advisory.note: B와 C는 목표의 절반씩만 충족하는 오답이고 A는 연혁만 다룬다. 전형적인 중간 난이도 구성이다. 다만 정답 D만 눈에 띄게 길고 포괄적이어서 길이만 보고도 고를 수 있다는 약점이 있다.

problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is a secure storage facility built into a mountain on a Norwegian island in the Arctic.
- It opened in 2008 and holds backup copies of seed samples deposited by gene banks around the world.
- The vault is kept at about −18°C, a temperature at which many seeds can remain viable for decades or even centuries.
- In 2015, the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) withdrew some of its deposited seeds after civil war in Syria damaged its gene bank near Aleppo.
- ICARDA used the withdrawn seeds to regrow its collections in Lebanon and Morocco and later returned fresh duplicates to the vault.
- The facility's entrance features an illuminated art installation by Norwegian artist Dyveke Sanne.

The student wants to emphasize that the Svalbard Global Seed Vault has fulfilled its purpose as a backup for the world's gene banks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is a secure storage facility built into a mountain on a Norwegian island in the Arctic.
- It opened in 2008 and holds backup copies of seed samples deposited by gene banks around the world.
- The vault is kept at about −18°C, a temperature at which many seeds can remain viable for decades or even centuries.
- In 2015, the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) withdrew some of its deposited seeds after civil war in Syria damaged its gene bank near Aleppo.
- ICARDA used the withdrawn seeds to regrow its collections in Lebanon and Morocco and later returned fresh duplicates to the vault.
- The facility's entrance features an illuminated art installation by Norwegian artist Dyveke Sanne.
problem.question: The student wants to emphasize that the Svalbard Global Seed Vault has fulfilled its purpose as a backup for the world's gene banks. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: When war damaged ICARDA's gene bank in Syria, the organization withdrew its duplicate seeds from the Svalbard Global Seed Vault and used them to rebuild its collections, showing that the vault worked as intended.
In 2015, ICARDA withdrew some of its seeds from the vault and used them to regrow collections in Lebanon and Morocco before returning fresh duplicates.

Opened in 2008 on an Arctic island in Norway, the Svalbard Global Seed Vault is a mountain facility that stores seed samples from gene banks around the world, keeps them at about −18°C, and features an illuminated art installation at its entrance.
Because the Svalbard Global Seed Vault is kept at about −18°C, many of the seeds stored there can remain viable for decades or even centuries.
problem.explanation:
정답 A: 목표는 저장고가 '백업'이라는 목적을 실제로 수행했음을 강조하는 것이다. A는 전쟁으로 원래 유전자은행이 손상됨(백업이 필요한 상황)과 저장고에서 꺼낸 종자로 컬렉션을 재건함(백업 기능 수행)을 함께 제시해 목표를 정확히 달성한다.
B(지나치게 세부적): ICARDA의 인출·재배 장소·재반납 등 세부 사항만 나열하고, 왜 인출했는지(Aleppo 유전자은행 손상)와 그것이 백업 역할의 증거라는 점이 빠져 있어 강조의 초점이 드러나지 않는다.
C(지나치게 포괄적): 위치, 개관 연도, 온도, 예술 작품까지 시설 전반을 개관할 뿐 실제로 목적을 수행했다는 사례가 없어 강조 목표를 잃는다.
D(다른 항목 강조): 저온 덕분에 종자가 오래 생존할 수 있다는 '잠재적' 보존 능력을 강조할 뿐, 실제 백업으로서 기능했다는 사실과는 다르다.
problem.explanationEn:
Correct answer A: The goal is to emphasize that the vault has actually done its job as a backup. Choice A gives both parts: war damaged ICARDA's original gene bank, which is why a backup was needed, and the seeds stored in the vault were used to rebuild the collections, which shows the backup worked. Together, these details accomplish the goal.
B (too detailed): It lists the specifics of the withdrawal, regrowth sites, and return. However, it leaves out why the seeds were withdrawn: the original gene bank was destroyed. It also never connects the event to the vault's role as a backup, so the point being emphasized is unclear.
C (too broad): It gives an overview of the facility's location, opening date, temperature, and even its artwork. It never shows the vault actually fulfilling its purpose, so it loses the focus the goal requires.
D (a different point): It stresses the vault's potential to preserve seeds for a long time because of the cold. That is not the same as showing the vault has actually served as a backup.

hardJudge.note: A는 4·5번 노트(손상 원인 + 인출·재건)를 종합해 '백업 목적 수행'이라는 목표를 명시적으로 뒷받침. B는 사실상 같은 사건을 다루지만 손상 원인과 '목적 달성' 프레임이 빠져 있어 변별력이 있으나, B를 '지나치게 세부적'으로 보기엔 다소 애매(세부보다는 초점 결여에 가까움). C 포괄적, D 잠재적 능력만 서술. 사실관계(2008 개관, −18°C, 2015 ICARDA 인출, Lebanon/Morocco 재배, Dyveke Sanne 설치물) 모두 정확. 해설 일관.

advisory.note: 정답 A는 손상(원인)과 재건(백업 기능)을 함께 묶었다. B는 세부만 늘어놓고 원인과 의미가 빠져 있어 그럴듯한 오답이다. C는 지나치게 포괄적이고 D는 잠재적 능력만 말한다. 사실관계는 정확하다(2015년 ICARDA 인출, 레바논·모로코). 난이도는 보통 수준보다 약간 높다.

problem.passage:
In the novel, the narrator returns to her grandmother's house on the moors after ten years away. The rooms are colder than she ______ the old clock in the hall has stopped at a quarter past four.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the novel, the narrator returns to her grandmother's house on the moors after ten years away. The rooms are colder than she ______ the old clock in the hall has stopped at a quarter past four.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "The rooms are colder than she remembers"와 뒤 "the old clock ... has stopped at a quarter past four"는 각각 독립절이다. 두 독립절은 쉼표와 등위접속사로 연결할 수 있으므로 C가 정답이다. A는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 스플라이스가 된다. B는 문장부호 없이 두 독립절을 붙인 무종지문(run-on sentence)이다. D는 쉼표가 접속사 앞이 아니라 뒤에 와서 표준 영어의 관례에 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The words before the blank, "The rooms are colder than she remembers," and the words after it, "the old clock ... has stopped at a quarter past four," are both independent clauses. You can join two independent clauses with a comma followed by a coordinating conjunction, so C is correct. A joins the clauses with only a comma, which makes a comma splice. B puts the clauses together with no punctuation at all, which makes a run-on sentence. D puts the comma after "and" instead of before it, which doesn't follow standard conventions.

hardJudge.note: 검산: "The rooms are colder than she remembers" / "the old clock in the hall has stopped at a quarter past four" 두 독립절을 쉼표+등위접속사(and)로 연결하는 C만 표준 관례에 부합. A 쉼표 스플라이스, B 융합문(무종지문), D 접속사 뒤 쉼표로 비표준. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 C와 선택지 글자 참조가 일치하고 모순 없음. 영어 해설 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 단일 규칙(독립절 연결)으로 풀리며 오답이 전형적 오개념이라 easy에 적합. 저작권 의심 없음.

advisory.note: 독립절 두 개를 쉼표+등위접속사로 잇는 단일 규칙을 묻는 문항이다. 오답은 쉼표 스플라이스, 무종지문, 쉼표 위치 오류로 전형적인 오개념이다. easy 난이도에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
In the early 1800s, many families in rural England spun wool and wove cloth at home. When large textile mills opened in towns such as Manchester, this pattern began to ______ young workers left their villages to take jobs operating the new machines.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the early 1800s, many families in rural England spun wool and wove cloth at home. When large textile mills opened in towns such as Manchester, this pattern began to ______ young workers left their villages to take jobs operating the new machines.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 'this pattern began to change'와 뒤 'young workers left their villages...'는 각각 주어와 동사를 갖춘 독립절이다. 두 독립절은 쉼표와 등위접속사로 연결할 수 있으므로 A가 정답이다. B는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 스플라이스가 된다. C는 아무 문장부호나 접속사 없이 두 절을 붙여 융합문이 된다. D는 쉼표를 접속사 'and' 뒤에 잘못 두어 관례에 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The text before the blank ("this pattern began to change") and the text after it ("young workers left their villages...") are both independent clauses, since each has its own subject and verb. You can join two independent clauses with a comma followed by a coordinating conjunction, so A is correct. B uses only a comma, which creates a comma splice. C joins the clauses with no punctuation or conjunction, which creates a run-on sentence. D puts the comma after "and" instead of before it, and that doesn't follow standard conventions.

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞뒤가 모두 독립절("this pattern began to change" / "young workers left their villages...")임을 직접 확인함. A(쉼표+등위접속사)가 유일하게 관례에 맞고, B는 쉼표 스플라이스, C는 융합문, D는 접속사 뒤 쉼표로 오류. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답과 선택지 글자 참조가 일치하며 모순 없음. 단일 규칙(독립절 연결)만으로 풀리고 오답이 전형적 오개념(쉼표 스플라이스 등)이라 easy 난이도에 적합. 역사적 배경(1800년대 초 맨체스터 방직공장)도 사실에 부합하며 저작권 의심 없음.

advisory.note: 독립절 두 개를 쉼표+등위접속사로 잇는 기본 규칙 하나로 풀 수 있다. 오답은 쉼표 스플라이스, 융합문, 쉼표 위치 오류로, 전형적인 오개념이다. 역사적 내용(산업혁명기 가내 방직에서 공장 노동으로의 이동)도 무리가 없다.

problem.passage:
In 1937, engineers finished building the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, California. The bridge's famous reddish color, called "International Orange," was not part of the original plan. Consulting architect Irving Morrow liked the color of the primer coating on the steel ______ he argued that it would stand out clearly in the region's frequent fog.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In 1937, engineers finished building the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, California. The bridge's famous reddish color, called "International Orange," was not part of the original plan. Consulting architect Irving Morrow liked the color of the primer coating on the steel ______ he argued that it would stand out clearly in the region's frequent fog.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "Consulting architect Irving Morrow liked the color of the primer coating on the steel beams"와 뒤 "he argued that it would stand out clearly in the region's frequent fog"는 각각 완전한 독립절이다. 두 독립절은 쉼표와 등위접속사로 연결할 수 있으므로 쉼표 뒤에 and가 오는 B가 정답이다. A는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 스플라이스가 된다. C는 문장부호나 접속사 없이 두 독립절을 붙여 무종지문이 된다. D는 쉼표를 접속사 뒤에 잘못 두어 and 앞에 있어야 할 쉼표가 빠졌다.
problem.explanationEn: The words before the blank, "Consulting architect Irving Morrow liked the color of the primer coating on the steel beams," and the words after it, "he argued that it would stand out clearly in the region's frequent fog," are both independent clauses. You can join two independent clauses with a comma followed by a coordinating conjunction, so B is correct. A uses only a comma, which creates a comma splice. C has no punctuation or conjunction at all, so it creates a run-on sentence. D puts the comma after "and" when it should come before it, so the clauses aren't joined correctly.

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞뒤 모두 독립절이며 B(쉼표+and)만 올바르게 연결함. A는 쉼표 스플라이스, C는 무종지문, D는 쉼표 위치 오류로 전형적 오개념 선택지. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 및 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 역사적 사실(1937년 완공, Irving Morrow, 프라이머 색상 유래) 정확. 단일 규칙(독립절 연결)으로 풀리는 easy 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: 독립절 두 개를 쉼표+등위접속사로 잇는 한 가지 규칙만 쓰는 전형적인 easy 문항이다. 오답은 쉼표 스플라이스, 무종지문, 쉼표 위치 오류로 모두 전형적인 오개념이다. 사실관계(1937년 완공, 모로가 프라이머 색을 선호하고 안개 속 가시성을 근거로 든 점)도 정확하다.

problem.passage:
Located in southern Bolivia, the Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt flat in the world. During the rainy season, a thin layer of water covers its surface, and the flat ______ the sky so clearly that visitors often feel as if they are walking among the clouds.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Located in southern Bolivia, the Salar de Uyuni is the largest salt flat in the world. During the rainy season, a thin layer of water covers its surface, and the flat ______ the sky so clearly that visitors often feel as if they are walking among the clouds.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸의 주어는 단수 명사 'the flat'이므로 동사도 단수형이어야 합니다. 또한 이 문장은 'covers'처럼 현재 시제로 일반적인 사실을 서술하고 있습니다. 따라서 단수 현재형인 A가 정답입니다. B, C, D는 모두 'the flat'처럼 단수 주어가 아니라 복수 주어에 쓰는 동사형이라 수 일치가 맞지 않습니다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the blank is "the flat," which is a singular noun, so the verb has to be singular too. The sentence also describes a general fact in the present tense, just like "covers." That makes A, the singular present-tense form, correct. B, C, and D are all verb forms used with plural subjects, so none of them agrees with the singular subject "the flat."

hardJudge.note: 주어 'the flat'(단수) + 현재 시제('covers'와 병렬) → 'reflects'가 유일한 단수 현재형. B/C/D는 모두 복수 주어용 형태로 해설 설명과 일치. 한·영 해설 결론·글자 참조 동일, 영어 자연스러움. 단일 규칙(주어-동사 수 일치)으로 해결되므로 easy 적합. 다만 빈칸 앞에 복수 유인 명사가 없어 오답 매력도가 다소 낮은 편이나 easy 수준에서는 허용 범위. Salar de Uyuni 관련 사실(볼리비아 남부, 세계 최대 소금사막) 정확.

advisory.note: 주어 'the flat'(단수)와 동사의 수 일치를 묻는 단일 규칙 문항입니다. 주어가 빈칸 바로 앞에 있어 easy 수준에 맞습니다. 오답은 모두 복수형이라 전형적인 오개념에 해당합니다. 소금사막 우유니에 관한 사실도 정확합니다.

problem.passage:
In 1937, engineers completed the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, California. To protect the bridge from salty fog and wind, crews painted its steel a bright reddish-orange color called "International Orange." Today, a team of painters ______ the bridge year-round, touching up spots where the coating has worn away.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In 1937, engineers completed the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco, California. To protect the bridge from salty fog and wind, crews painted its steel a bright reddish-orange color called "International Orange." Today, a team of painters ______ the bridge year-round, touching up spots where the coating has worn away.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'a team'이고, 'of painters'는 주어를 꾸미는 짧은 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 단수 동사가 필요하므로 C의 'maintains'가 정답이다. A의 'maintain', B의 'have maintained', D의 'are maintaining'은 모두 복수 동사 형태로, 바로 앞 단어 'painters'에 맞춘 것이라 단수 주어 'team'과 수가 일치하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "a team." The phrase "of painters" is just a short modifier describing the team. Because the subject is singular, you need a singular verb, so C, "maintains," is correct. A ("maintain"), B ("have maintained"), and D ("are maintaining") are all plural verb forms. They match the nearby word "painters" instead of the singular subject "team," so they don't agree with it.

hardJudge.note: 주어 'a team'(단수) + 'of painters' 수식어 구조로 단수 동사 'maintains'만 적합. 오답 3개 모두 복수형으로 'painters'에 끌린 전형적 오개념 선택지. 'Today ... year-round'와 현재 단순시제도 자연스러움. 사실(1937 완공, International Orange)도 정확. 해설 한·영 모두 정답 및 글자 참조 일치.

advisory.note: 'a team of painters' 주어-동사 수일치 문항이다. 수식어구를 사이에 둔 전형적인 easy 문항이다. 사실 관계도 맞다(1937년 완공, International Orange). 'team'은 영국식 영어에서 복수 취급될 수 있으나, SAT 표준 영어에서는 단수 취급하므로 문제없다.

problem.passage:
Sea otters play an important role in kelp forest ecosystems along the Pacific coast. The otters eat large numbers of sea urchins, which feed on kelp. When otter populations decline, urchin numbers rise quickly, and the kelp forests that shelter many fish ______ to shrink.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Sea otters play an important role in kelp forest ecosystems along the Pacific coast. The otters eat large numbers of sea urchins, which feed on kelp. When otter populations decline, urchin numbers rise quickly, and the kelp forests that shelter many fish ______ to shrink.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 빈칸 동사의 주어는 복수 명사 "the kelp forests"이고, "that shelter many fish"는 주어를 꾸미는 수식절일 뿐이다. 따라서 복수 동사가 필요하며, 앞의 "decline", "rise"와 맞춰 현재 시제를 쓴 D "begin"이 정답이다. A "begins", B "has begun", C "is beginning"은 모두 단수 동사라서 복수 주어 "forests"와 수가 일치하지 않는다. 수식절의 "fish"나 "kelp"를 단수 주어로 착각하면 이런 오답을 고르기 쉽다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the blank is the plural noun "the kelp forests." The phrase "that shelter many fish" only describes the subject. So you need a plural verb, and the present tense matches "decline" and "rise" earlier in the sentence. That makes D, "begin," correct. A ("begins"), B ("has begun"), and C ("is beginning") are all singular verbs, so they don't agree with the plural subject "forests." These choices can seem right if you mistake "kelp" or "fish" for a singular subject.

hardJudge.note: 주어 "the kelp forests"(복수)와 동사 수일치 문제. 수식절 "that shelter many fish"가 끼어들어 "fish"를 주어로 오인하게 하는 전형적 오답 구조. A/B/C 모두 단수형이라 규칙을 알면 즉시 배제 가능. 해설 한·영 일치, 선택지 글자 참조 정확, 사실 오류 없음, 저작권 의심 없음. easy 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: 이 문항은 주어-동사 수 일치를 묻는다. 복수 주어 'forests'에는 'begin'이 맞고, 단수 동사 형태인 나머지 세 선택지는 규칙만 알면 바로 걸러진다. 'kelp'처럼 바로 앞에 놓인 단수 명사가 주어처럼 보이게 하는 함정도 easy 수준에 알맞다. 'fish'는 단수로도 복수로도 쓰여 함정으로서의 힘은 약하지만, 해설 내용에는 문제가 없다.

problem.passage:
Astronomers studying the Crab Nebula have long been puzzled by its brightest wisps, which shift position over a matter of days rather than centuries. According to a team at the University of Bonn, the rapid motion of these filaments, along with the intense gamma-ray flares that sometimes accompany ______ from shock waves rippling outward from the pulsar at the nebula's center.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Astronomers studying the Crab Nebula have long been puzzled by its brightest wisps, which shift position over a matter of days rather than centuries. According to a team at the University of Bonn, the rapid motion of these filaments, along with the intense gamma-ray flares that sometimes accompany ______ from shock waves rippling outward from the pulsar at the nebula's center.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'the rapid motion'이고, 'of these filaments'와 'along with ... them'은 주어를 꾸미는 삽입 요소일 뿐 수에 영향을 주지 않는다. 따라서 단수 정동사 'results'가 필요하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 가까이 있는 복수 명사 'filaments'나 'flares'에 맞춘 복수 동사여서 주어와 수가 일치하지 않는다. C의 분사 'resulting'과 D의 부정사 'to result'는 정동사가 아니어서 'According to' 뒤의 주절에 본동사가 없게 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "the rapid motion." The phrases "of these filaments" and "along with ... them" only modify that subject, so they don't change its number. The sentence therefore needs the singular finite verb "results," which makes A correct. B uses the plural verb "result," which wrongly agrees with the nearby plural nouns "filaments" or "flares" instead of the subject. C uses a participle and D uses an infinitive, and neither one is a finite verb, so with either choice the main clause would have no main verb.

hardJudge.note: 주어 'the rapid motion'(단수)과 동사 사이에 'of these filaments', 'along with ... accompany them' 등 긴 삽입구가 있어 가까운 복수 명사(filaments/flares)에 끌려 B를 고르기 쉽게 설계됨. A가 유일하게 단수 정동사를 제공하며, C·D는 정동사 부재로 문장 불성립. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 및 오답 배제 근거가 정확하고 일관됨. 크랩 성운 위스프의 수일 단위 이동과 감마선 플레어는 실제 관측 사실과 부합. 두 단계 판단(주어 식별 + 정동사 여부)을 요구하므로 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 주어 'the rapid motion'과 동사 사이에 'of these filaments'와 'along with ... them'이 끼어 있습니다. 그래서 수 일치를 판단하는 데 두 단계가 필요합니다. 하나는 주어를 찾고 삽입구를 빼는 것이고, 다른 하나는 정동사가 필요한지 확인하는 것입니다. 오답 B는 가까이 있는 복수 명사에 맞춘 동사라서 훑어 읽으면 고르기 쉬운 함정입니다. C와 D는 정동사가 없는 문장을 만듭니다. 이 문항은 medium 난이도에 맞습니다. 본 대학 연구팀이라는 설정은 지어낸 것일 수 있지만, 지문이 사실 여부를 묻지 않으므로 문제가 되지 않습니다.

problem.passage:
When the Finnish architect Alvar Aalto designed the Paimio Sanatorium in the late 1920s, he treated the patient's bed, rather than the building's facade, as the starting point. The series of ceiling panels above each bed, painted in soft colors and angled to keep glare away from a reclining patient's eyes, ______ that the building had been planned from the perspective of someone lying down, a choice critics still cite as an early example of human-centered design.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: When the Finnish architect Alvar Aalto designed the Paimio Sanatorium in the late 1920s, he treated the patient's bed, rather than the building's facade, as the starting point. The series of ceiling panels above each bed, painted in soft colors and angled to keep glare away from a reclining patient's eyes, ______ that the building had been planned from the perspective of someone lying down, a choice critics still cite as an early example of human-centered design.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'series'이고, 'of ceiling panels'와 'painted ... eyes'는 모두 주어를 꾸미는 수식어이므로 단수 정동사가 필요하다. D 'reveals'는 단수형이고, 지금도 확인할 수 있는 사실을 서술하는 현재 시제여서 'still cite'와도 어울린다. A와 C는 바로 앞의 복수 명사 'panels'나 'eyes'에 수를 맞춘 복수형이어서 단수 주어 'series'와 일치하지 않는다. B 'revealing'은 분사이므로 문장에 정동사가 없게 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the sentence is the singular noun "series." Both "of ceiling panels" and the phrase "painted ... eyes" only describe that subject, so the sentence needs a singular finite verb. Choice D, "reveals," is singular, and its present tense fits a fact we can still observe today, which matches "still cite." Choices A and C are plural forms that agree with the nearby nouns "panels" or "eyes" instead of with "series." Choice B, "revealing," is a participle, so it would leave the sentence without a main verb.

hardJudge.note: 주어 'series'(단수)와 긴 수식어('of ceiling panels', 'painted ... eyes') 뒤의 정동사 일치 문제. D 'reveals'가 유일한 단수 정동사이며 현재 시제가 'still cite'와 호응. A·C는 인접 복수 명사에 이끌린 오답, B는 정동사 부재. 한·영 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치. Aalto의 Paimio Sanatorium(1929년 설계) 관련 사실 무리 없음. 중간 난이도 적합.

advisory.note: 'The series'는 정관사가 붙은 단수 주어이므로 정답은 D 'reveals'입니다. 주어와 동사 사이에 'of ceiling panels'와 길게 이어지는 분사구가 끼어 있어, 복수 명사인 panels와 eyes가 수 일치를 헷갈리게 하는 함정이 됩니다. 정답을 고르려면 두 단계가 필요합니다. 먼저 수식어를 걷어 내 주어가 단수임을 확인하고, 그다음 분사형인 B를 정동사가 될 수 없다는 이유로 제외해야 합니다. 이 판단 과정은 medium 난이도에 맞습니다. 다만 'a series of'는 복수로 받는 경우도 있어서, 해당 용법을 아는 수험생이 잠시 망설일 수 있습니다. 그래도 이 문장은 정관사 'The'가 붙어 있으므로 단수로 보는 해석이 표준입니다.

problem.passage:
Brazilian ceramicist Lúcia Moreira spent nearly a decade studying diatoms, single-celled algae whose silica shells form intricate geometric patterns, under a borrowed laboratory microscope. The series of porcelain vessels that she eventually produced from her sketches of these organisms, each one enlarged thousands of times and glazed to mimic the glassy sheen of a living cell, ______ now part of the permanent collection at a natural history museum in São Paulo.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Brazilian ceramicist Lúcia Moreira spent nearly a decade studying diatoms, single-celled algae whose silica shells form intricate geometric patterns, under a borrowed laboratory microscope. The series of porcelain vessels that she eventually produced from her sketches of these organisms, each one enlarged thousands of times and glazed to mimic the glassy sheen of a living cell, ______ now part of the permanent collection at a natural history museum in São Paulo.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 "The series"이고, 이 주어에 대한 정동사가 빈칸에 와야 한다. 따라서 단수 정동사 is를 쓴 A가 정답이다. B의 are는 정동사이긴 하지만, 바로 앞에 있는 vessels, organisms 같은 복수 명사에 맞춘 것이라 단수 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C의 being과 D의 having been은 분사일 뿐 정동사가 아니어서, 이것을 넣으면 문장에 주동사가 없는 불완전한 문장이 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "The series," and the blank needs a finite verb that goes with that subject. That's why A, the singular finite verb "is," is correct. B's "are" is a finite verb, but it agrees with nearby plural nouns like "vessels" and "organisms," not with the singular subject. C's "being" and D's "having been" are only participles, not finite verbs, so either one would leave the sentence without a main verb, making it incomplete.

hardJudge.note: 주어 "The series"(단수)와 정동사 "is"의 일치가 정확하며, 긴 수식어구(vessels, organisms, cell 등 복수·단수 명사 혼재)와 동격 분사구가 삽입되어 주어 식별 + 수 일치라는 두 단계 판단을 요구한다. B는 인접 복수 명사에 끌린 유력 오답, C·D는 정동사 부재로 배제되는 전형적 SAT 구조. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답과 선택지 참조가 일치하고 모순 없음. 가상의 인물(Lúcia Moreira)로 저작권·사실 오류 없음.

advisory.note: 주어 'The series'와 동사 사이에 수식어구가 길게 끼어 있고 복수 명사(vessels, sketches, organisms)와 독립분사구가 들어 있다. 그래서 주어를 찾아 수를 맞추고 정동사 여부까지 확인하는 두 단계 판단이 필요하다. 'series'는 단수와 복수 형태가 같지만, 'The series of ...'는 SAT 관례상 단수로 처리하므로 정답 A가 성립한다. C와 D는 비정동사라서 바로 배제된다.

problem.passage:
In 1974, radio astronomers Russell Hulse and Joseph Taylor detected a pulsar orbiting a companion neutron star every 7.75 hours. Over the following years, careful timing of the pulsar's signals, which arrive at Earth with extraordinary regularity, ______ that the two stars were slowly spiraling toward each other at precisely the rate predicted if the system were losing energy through gravitational waves.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In 1974, radio astronomers Russell Hulse and Joseph Taylor detected a pulsar orbiting a companion neutron star every 7.75 hours. Over the following years, careful timing of the pulsar's signals, which arrive at Earth with extraordinary regularity, ______ that the two stars were slowly spiraling toward each other at precisely the rate predicted if the system were losing energy through gravitational waves.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 "timing"이고, "of the pulsar's signals"와 관계절 "which arrive ... regularity"는 주어를 꾸미는 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 이 주어에는 단수 정동사가 필요하고, B의 "revealed"는 과거시제로 수와 상관없이 쓸 수 있으며 "Over the following years"라는 과거 시간 표현과도 맞는다. A의 "have revealed"와 D의 "were revealing"은 바로 앞의 복수 명사 "signals"에 수를 맞춘 형태라서 단수 주어 "timing"과 일치하지 않는다. C의 "revealing"은 분사여서 정동사가 아니므로 문장에 본동사가 없게 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "timing." The phrase "of the pulsar's signals" and the clause "which arrive ... regularity" only modify that subject. That means the sentence needs a finite verb that agrees with a singular subject. B, "revealed," is a past-tense verb that works with singular and plural subjects alike, and it also fits the past time frame set by "Over the following years." A, "have revealed," and D, "were revealing," are plural forms that match the nearby noun "signals" instead of the actual subject "timing." C, "revealing," is a participle, not a finite verb, so it would leave the sentence without a main verb.

hardJudge.note: 주어 "timing"(단수)을 수식어("of the pulsar's signals", which 관계절) 너머로 식별해야 하며, 과거 시간 표현과의 시제 적합성까지 확인해야 하는 2단계 판단. A·D는 근접 명사 "signals"에 이끌리는 함정, C는 정동사 부재. 정답 B 검산 완료. Hulse–Taylor 펄서(1974, 7.75시간 공전) 사실 관계 정확. 한·영 해설 모두 결론·글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음.

advisory.note: 주어와 동사 사이에 전치사구와 관계절이 길게 끼어 있어 문장을 정독해야 풀 수 있다. 수 일치와 정동사 여부를 둘 다 따져야 하는 두 단계 판단 구조이고, 오답 A와 D는 근처의 복수 명사 signals에 이끌리도록 설계되어 있다. 이는 중간 난이도에 맞다. 펄서의 공전 주기 약 7.75시간을 비롯한 Hulse-Taylor 사실관계도 정확하다.
